scope: Repair post-proposal recovery so acceptance tests are phase-independent and historical Evidence Maps remain isolated from the active Work Order.
required_outputs: Active Work Order Evidence Map isolation
Fresh exact-head Reviewer and Verifier PASS
Fresh Evidence Map and post-build critique
Replacement checkpoint proposal without rewriting H0-0-WO-001
stop_conditions: Any runtime or canonical contract path would need to change
Historical H0-0-WO-001 events would need mutation
A blocking Human Attention decision is required
risk_reasons: The repair changes which Evidence Maps may authorize an active checkpoint.
Incorrect multi-Work-Order isolation could use stale historical review evidence.
The public recovery contract must remain valid after a terminal proposal and a follow-up Work Order.

design_brief.problem_statement: After H0-0-WO-001 reached CHECKPOINT_PROPOSED, a live acceptance test remained hardcoded to the preceding STALE review phase; opening a recovery Work Order also exposes global Evidence Map identity checks across historical Work Orders.
design_brief.current_behavior: The suite passes only before fresh review/evidence is recorded, and a second Work Order would reject valid historical Evidence Maps as identity mismatches against the new active Work Order.
design_brief.desired_behavior: Acceptance tests derive freshness expectations from current Git state, while state reconstruction validates every canonical Evidence Map and selects only maps belonging to the active Work Order for its review and checkpoint gates.
alternatives_considered: Delete or relocate historical Evidence Maps.
Create H0-0-WO-002 and implement active Work Order map isolation with phase-independent tests.
design_brief.selected_design: Preserve all H0-0-WO-001 commits/events, create a new bounded Work Order, validate all claimed Evidence Maps, filter validated maps by active work_order_id before checkpoint identity and freshness evaluation, and make tests branch-phase independent.
design_brief.why_selected: This keeps events immutable, retains historical review evidence, prevents cross-Work-Order authorization, and makes clean-checkout recovery valid at every checkpoint phase.
expected_risks: Historical map authorizing active Work Order
Empty active map set hidden by prior maps
Tests coupled to a particular ledger phase
validation_plan: Validate every document claiming the canonical Evidence Map schema before filtering.
Prove historical maps remain visible as valid history but cannot enter active review state.
Prove an active Work Order without its own map remains checkpoint-blocked.
Prove wrong checkpoint/risk identity on the active Work Order map fails closed.
Run the full suite both before and after fresh active review/evidence records are appended.
Run root/non-root Status, Plan and Resume from a clean canonical URL clone.
Verify C22 remains blocked, runtime remains unauthorized and PC0 remains non-RED.

notes: This Work Order supersedes only the unaccepted checkpoint proposal for delivery purposes; H0-0-WO-001 remains immutable historical evidence.
